paragraphs: Chapter 646
164. Land of Evil Spirits (8)
Ilina simply couldn't understand Rosa.
Up until a couple of hours ago, Rosa had been extremely cautious about her mental breakdown.

Her attitude had never changed since the contract with Ilina was made. Threats, persuasion, temptation. No matter how she was approached, Rosa never abandoned her principle. The principle that she would never completely assimilate with her power and the chaos.
However, the current Rosa is showing a completely different behavior from before.
Ilina anticipated that if she accelerated the chaos now, Rosa's mind would undoubtedly collapse.
No, it was a certainty.
'If Lam's cannon is fired, she will definitely lose all her rationality and will...!'
As Rosa said, her will breaking was something Ilina had always hoped for.
But if it happens now, it would be a problem. If Rosa's will, the mediator, disappears at this point when so much chaos has been consumed, too much time would be needed for recovery.
If the enemies finish their reorganization and attack the Garden of Swords again, Ilina wasn't confident she could handle it.
Unlike the two major powers who are losing their fleet strength, Jin only had personal injuries. And since there were no fatal wounds, he wouldn't need much time to recover.

"Yes, you're right. I've been looking forward to your collapse. But if you collapse now, I can't take responsibility for the aftermath alone. I'm serious. You didn't plan this from the beginning, did you?"
The charging of the cannon was almost complete.

"If you had made this decision before summoning the Ten Knights, before you personally took action, of course it would have been a joyous event for me. But now... it's not possible. It's a foolish decision not to respond!"
[So, you can get scared too.]
Rosa's eyes twinkled black.
In the end, Ilina kneeled and stopped Rosa, but of course,
Rosa had no intention of stopping.
[Only I... can defeat the youngest. I mean, I can cut off the chains protecting that shining child.]
Kwa-ah-ah-ah...!
Lam's cannon was once again spewing a black line that bisected the sky.
It seemed like a black tide was spreading out behind Murakan.
Even for Murakan, who had been easily handling Rosa's secret techniques all along, Lam's cannon was a shock.
[This is insane...!]
He couldn't avoid it.
The cannon, which had driven two fleets of the Zifl into annihilation with a single strike, held a more terrifying power than before.
Heh, hahaha...!
Amidst the immense roar caused by the cannon, the laughter of the mad Rosa echoed. The entire sky and earth, steeped in chaos, seemed to laugh along with her.
"Ascend!" Jin shouted.
Murakan originally planned to block the cannon fire and descend, but as always, he followed Jin's opinion.
Jin thought it was right to direct Lam's bombardment upwards.
Although it would move further away from the escape point, he thought that if Lam's cannon was directed downwards, the entire forest where the Red Owl was located would disappear.
Then the escape would be over. The moment Murakan is forced to return, the rest of the group would be as good as dead.
Murakan accelerated upwards. The protective barriers of spiritual energy he had put behind him were torn apart.
Even before everything shattered, the shock began to transmit. Jin and Kaio managed to maintain consciousness amidst the pain.
[Kuaaaaaa...!]
Soon, Murakan swept away the clouds of chaos as he escaped from the cannon fire.
The spiritual energy barrier was thoroughly damaged, but there was no fatal harm.
The barrier was replenished in an instant. Even Jin admired Murakan's power at that point, but the problem was that the cannon fire had not ended.
[Damn...! It wouldn't reload quickly, would it?]
"That's right."
Unlike Murakan, who was only looking forward and flying, Jin checked the status of Lam, looking backward.
"Just now."
The ship of the abyss, Lam, was opening its dark maw again. Already, a new cannon seemed to be forming.
[Darn it, if it wasn't for that Oergal bastard, we wouldn't have been able to conserve our energy and escaping would've been nearly impossible...]
Rosa's maniacal laughter continued to weigh heavily on the group's mind. It felt like Lam was mocking them.
Chills ran down their spines.
If Glicke had awakened a primal fear inherent in life, Rosa's madness now was digging a dark pit in the human heart.
Not chaos, but a certain spite within a human being was piercing through the insides of those who watched in apprehension.
Rosa let out an exclamation of admiration.
It was a strange feeling. She had fired the cannon to kill him, yet the fact that he survived as always was delightfully insane to her.
I felt a level of happiness I had never experienced since birth.
The power gathered in Lam's maw once again aimed at Murakan.
Even though he looked like a dot from afar, Rosa felt as if her son was vividly in front of her.
Around then, Irina concluded that Rosa's sanity had completely collapsed.
So, she had to somehow control her before firing the second cannon. Rosa seemed to continue firing until Lam was completely shattered.
Thump!
A dagger stabbed into Rosa's back. It was a dagger pulled out from Irina's possession.
The blade pierced accurately through the spine and the heart, and Rosa paused for a moment with a flinch.
"Stop! If this goes on, you'll die too!"
Rosa didn't look back at Irina. She didn't even look at the blade sticking out from the center of her chest.
Instead, she fired the main cannon. A strange laugh, like the sound of metal, was still leaking from her parched lips.
Even the minimum chaos protecting Lam this time was all gathered.
'Everything is over like this...!'
With her drained strength, Irina barely managed to pull the dagger from Rosa's back.
She tried to stab her neck next.
But somehow, she couldn't exert any force.
To be precise, her body wouldn't move no matter how hard she tried. Something invisible was restraining Irina.
Krrrrk-! Kwadoog!
At the same time, Lam's massive hull tilted once to the right. With the hull's protective barrier gone, the fleets of the two powers were now striking Lam in earnest.
Of the cannons reaching a thousand feet, a few reached the head of Lam where they stood.
Holes were pierced in various parts of the head, and sharp fragments and debris stabbed into Rosa's body.
Such bombardments, Irina could easily block them.
If only her body would move. If only she could handle the power of chaos that was imprisoned with her, it would be as easy as breathing.
Irina could do nothing. All she could do was to keep the posture of trying to stab Rosa and watch the bombardment fall.
'What exactly... is restraining me!?'
Irina's heart pounded as if it would burst, looking at Rosa's back.
'Rosa. It can't be!'
A human turned into a monster of chaos, having lost their reason, couldn't possibly restrain her.
But the power that was restraining her was clearly Rosa's.
"So, you... the fairy tale isn't over yet...?"
[Quietly...]
As Rosa
started to speak, fear welled up in Irina's eyes.
[Stay quiet... I don't want to be disturbed by anyone now.]
Then, the restraint from Rosa that bound Irina was lifted. Forced to kneel and gasping for air, Irina had no choice but to follow her words.
She was, literally, overwhelmed.
By the human called Rosa Runcandel.
[Do you see it too, little one? Many enemies rushing to kill this mother, their cannon fire! But nothing can reach me directly. There's no need to block or avoid.]
Because it's fate.
In the fate laid between you and me, no trivial thing can interfere.
Just as Rosa said, despite so many attacks striking the head, not a single cannon reached her directly. All were slightly off, only causing debris to scatter.
Wholeheartedly.
Rosa was looking at the youngest with all her heart. She was picturing only him being shot dead.
Eventually, a smile spread across Rosa's lips.
Simultaneously, the second cannon that Lam held started reaching out towards Murakan. The darkness of the abyss was covering the party again.
The time allowed for Murakan had reached its end, particularly at that moment.
"Downward!"
This time, a descent.
It was the end anyway. Murakan was about to disappear, and the party had no power to block the second cannon fire.
Before the cannon fire reached, Murakan's time would end first.
[Little one!]
"I won't die...!"
Jin held on to Talares and Mot with all his might.
Then, with the blade pointing downward, he bit into the Bradamante with his mouth.
Kaio clearly understood what Jin was thinking.
"Aim point!"
"The center of the forest!"
Therefore, Kaio also hastily fixed both his feet to the wound on Murakan's back. Pulling back the god-bow Shin-sal, aiming at the blade of Bradamante.
By then, Murakan's body was becoming translucent, and Lam's cannon fire seemed to reach Murakan's tail.
"Shoot!"
As soon as their eyes met, Kaio released the bowstring.
Swoosh...!
The arrow of Shin-sal struck the blade of Bradamante.
Feeling as if his head was being ripped apart and his waist was bending, Jin endured the terrible recoil transmitted from the arrow with his whole body.
Together with Talares and Mot, whom he was tightly holding with both arms.
Jin started to fall into the forest where the red owl was. In the arrow stuck to Bradamante like a magnet, Kaio's last will to definitely save his brothers was embedded.
The moment Lam's main cannon covered them.
Murakan disappeared, fixing his gaze on Jin, and Kaio gave a thumbs-up in the sky.
His arrow showed an incredible force to immediately thrust Jin, Talares, and Mot into the middle of the forest.
"Cough...!"
Spitting out a clot of blood, Jin immediately got up and checked on Talares and Mot.
Talares was almost unconscious from the internal injury and the shock of the arrow, and Mot was motionless as if he were dead.
Looking around, he couldn't see the red owl.
Even though he fell into the center of the forest, he was about five hundred steps away from the red owl.
'Which way...!'
At times like this, the forest is like a maze.
The next cannon fire will fall into the forest.
At a difficult moment to get a grip, Mot opened the dimensional gate to the otherworldly snowy field. Black spots of chaos were seen here and there in the pure white snowfield.
If the error was out of a thousand steps, Mot wouldn't have been able to open the dimensional gate. Like fate, the last remaining power for Mot was exactly a limit of five hundred steps.
Mot, who entered through the dimensional gate, ran a few steps in the otherworldly snowfield and sent Jin and Talares to the location where the red owl was.
Calmly and quickly, Jin carried Talares up into the cockpit of the red owl.
When he pressed the button in the center of the cockpit, the red owl started accelerating with magical vibrations.
The acceleration needed for space leap is about 10 seconds.
'All that's left is to hope that the next cannon fire won't be ready by then...!'
One.
Two.
Three….
Nine.
The space leap started.
Jin, wrapped in the unique numbness of space leap, looked up at Lam.
He felt like he made eye contact with Rosa.
[You will come to find this mother again soon. I'll be waiting...]
Staring at the forest where Jin disappeared, Rosa was calming her chest-throbbing delight.
